narr: A line of thunderstorms trained across parts of the tri-state area, bringing flash flooding to portions of southeast Alabama and southwest Georgia. Considerable flash flooding occurred across Houston county, Alabama where rainfall amounts near 7 inches were measured in just a few hours. In Georgia, rainfall amounts around 5 inches were observed. For the Florida panhandle, rainfall amounts were not as high, but there was one measured gust in excess of 60 mph.
ev: Water was reported over roadways in the areas of W US Highway 84 and N Highway 123.
South County Road 9 was flooded south of Slocomb.
Roads were flooded in the Rehobeth area.
Several inches to near a foot of water was over the roadway along portions of 3rd Ave in Dothan.
There were numerous reports of water over the roads between Dothan and Cottonwood.
There were numerous sections of SR-52 flooded between Columbia and Dothan. The water depth was just under 1 foot deep in the worst sections.
Main Street in Webb was flooded with water up to 1 foot deep.
Several inches of water was moving across the roadway along Highway 231 south of Dothan.
Water entered a few homes on Academy Drive in Ashford.
Patterson Road was impassible due to water over a foot deep flowing over the roadway.
A paved road washed out when the drainage pipe broke loose under the road along Hodgesville Road near Hooper Cherry Road.
Water around 18 inches deep surrounded a mobile home and vehicle in the Taylor area.

Flash flooding washed out the gravel from underneath train tracks in the Cowarts area. This resulted in a train become stranded, which blocked North Broad Street, Jester Street, and Glen Lawrence Road where they connect to Highway 84.
Dunn Road was closed between Kinsey and Webb due to water over the roadway.
Flooding was reported at the Lions Club along US-84 East. The water was up to 1 foot deep on portions of the property.
There were numerous videos showing 1 foot or more of water flowing through residential yards and business parking lots.
Water was over a foot deep with water over the tires on a car in Webb near the Dollar General. The nearby park and roadway were also flooded.
